title: Sistema de Soporte de Decision
summary: A decision-support system for software project management that generates synthetic data for projects, modules, and defects, using database-backed models. It trains and samples SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and HMASynthesizer (with SingleTable/MultiTableMetadata) to produce single- and multi-table synthetic datasets.
